name: Time Zone Converter
tagline: Pick a time in one city and see it in others.
seoTitle: Time zone converter and meeting planner
description: Convert a time between cities and time zones, with daylight saving handled exactly and working hours marked. Free, no sign-up, works offline.

specs.Daylight saving: Handled for the exact date you pick

faq.a: Yes. It uses your browser's built-in time zone database, so the offset is right for the date you choose, not just today.
08:00 to 18:00 local time. Times outside that are marked, so you can spot a bad meeting time at a glance.
